card.name: The ending -ally in renally
card.fires_on: The final piece "ally" completing "renally" in drug-interaction text, as in "renally eliminated drugs" or "renally excreted". It also fires weakly on a few other adverb endings.

modes.label: Renally eliminated drugs
modes.description: The ending "ally" after "ren" in warnings about drugs cleared by the kidneys.
modes.example: with drugs that are excreted ren<<ally>> or with other drugs known to affect renal

modes.label: Other adverb endings
modes.description: An adverb ending or a closing word in a hedge, such as "molecularly" or "at most" and "at best".
modes.example: The components are molecular<<ly>> attached to each other
